2014_spells.beacon-of-hope.description: This spell bestows hope and vitality. Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has advantage on wisdom saving throws and death saving throws, and regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.
2014_spells.beacon-of-hope.effectSummary: Give a creature advantage on saving throws for the duration
2014_spells.beacon-of-hope.fullDescripti: Using 1 action, choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has advantage on wisdom saving throws and death saving throws, and regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing; This spell bestows hope and vitality. The effect lasts for up to 1 minute; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
